name: Quidget – AI Chatbot & Live Chat
author: Quidget

sections.description:
AI-powered chatbot and live chat plugin for WordPress. Automate customer support, qualify leads, and provide instant answers—without losing the human touch.

Quidget makes it easy for businesses to offer real-time AI chat support and seamlessly switch to human agents when needed. Whether you’re running an e-commerce store, a service-based business, or a SaaS company, Quidget helps you manage customer interactions efficiently while reducing support costs.

Key Features

  • AI Chatbot for Customer Support and Sales – Handles up to 80% of customer inquiries using data from your website, FAQs, and knowledge base.
  • Live Chat with AI + Human Handoff – Seamless transition from AI to real support agents.
  • No-Code AI Agent Builder – Train AI assistants without technical skills.
  • Multi-Channel Support – Integrate with WhatsApp, Messenger, and email.
  • Fast Setup and Easy Integration – No coding required.

Who Should Use Quidget?

  • E-commerce Stores – Help customers find products, answer shipping questions, and handle order-related inquiries automatically.
  • SaaS and Tech Companies – Automate customer support and assist users with product setup and troubleshooting.
  • Service-Based Businesses – Qualify leads, book appointments, and provide real-time customer assistance.
  • Agencies and Consultants – Offer AI-powered chat support to clients and streamline communication.

Support

For help, visit Quidget Support.

Security & Privacy

  • The plugin does not store any user data locally.
  • The Web Chat ID is sanitized and used solely to load the official Quidget widget.
  • No third-party scripts are allowed; only the verified Quidget loader is used.
sections.installation:
Quidget lets you easily integrate a chatbot onto your WordPress site. This setup helps you provide instant AI-powered assistance to visitors.

  1. Log in to your WordPress admin dashboard
    Go to: yourdomain.com/wp-admin/
    You can also access it through your hosting provider’s control panel.

  2. Install and activate the Quidget plugin

    • In the left sidebar of your WordPress admin dashboard, click Plugins.
    • Click Add New at the top of the page.
    • In the search bar, type “Quidget”.
    • Locate the Quidget plugin, then click Install Now.
    • Once installed, click Activate.

  3. Get your Web Chat ID from Quidget

    • Go to the Test & Install page in your Quidget account.
    • Click on the WordPress button.
    • In the popup that appears, click Copy ID — this is your Web Chat ID.

  4. Add your Web Chat ID to the plugin

    • In the WordPress admin dashboard sidebar, find and click on Quidget Chat.
    • Paste your Chat ID into the field labeled “Web Chat ID”.
    • Click Save Changes.
